title: StatusResponse
description:
The status of an asynchronous event.

Compare `numCompleted` against `numRequested` to track the progress of an event. When an event finishes with failures, `failures` describes each one.

eventStatus.description: The current status of the asynchronous event.

eventType.description: The type of the asynchronous event.

failures.description: The set of failures that occurred while the server processed the event.

mdmInfo.description: The client-specific information that the server stores for your device management service.

numCompleted.description: The number of tasks from the request that the server completed.

numRequested.description: The total number of tasks in the request.

tokenExpirationDate.description:
The token expiration date in an ISO-8601 format.

Note: The server shows all dates and times in UTC.

uId.description: The unique library identifier. When querying records using multiple tokens that may share libraries, use the `uId` field to filter duplicates and avoid double-counting records when different content managers upload duplicate tokens.
